observations.noto-sc: Letter and time shapes are clear, but curly apostrophes have conspicuously wide spacing in De l’île and Besoin d’aide. Exact cmap/shaping passed; the actual French typography is unsuitable.
observations.wyvern: Digits remain distinguishable, but narrow condensed-looking letters fight the intended open calm direction; weak body presence compared with Source.
observations.source-sans: Retains comfortable French spacing, clear 1/7/0 and stronger practical hierarchy. No material advantage from C alternatives.

final.revision_reason: No further revision: retain established Source sizes after rejecting unsuitable rendered alternatives.
final.decision: Retain A/B Source Sans Pro. First-pass C adds no improvement: Noto Sans SC has distracting full-width-like curly apostrophe spacing in French despite passing exact coverage; Wyvern appears too condensed for the requested open treatment.
final.counterargument: Noto Sans SC has robust clear digits and could potentially be fixed with other OpenType width features; that was not investigated within this comparison. Source benefits from prior size tuning.

objective_checks.evidence: Only exact compositor PNG inspected; CSS/HTML recipes not staged with font assets or browser-tested.

objective_checks.evidence: Visual inspection of final full-size composition and exact role coverage.

audience_context_fit.observation: Bilingual notice and time columns remain easy to scan.

hierarchy.observation: Dates and times clearly stand apart.

role_pairing_coherence.observation: Single-family coherence with natural French punctuation spacing.

subjective_assessment.overall_preference: Retain A/B Source Sans Pro. First-pass C adds no improvement: Noto Sans SC has distracting full-width-like curly apostrophe spacing in French despite passing exact coverage; Wyvern appears too condensed for the requested open treatment.
subjective_assessment.counterargument: Noto Sans SC has robust clear digits and could potentially be fixed with other OpenType width features; that was not investigated within this comparison. Source benefits from prior size tuning.

limitations: Internal formative self-assessment; no causal or statistical proof of improved typography.
Same evaluator sees sequential conditions; later stages can benefit from familiarity.
Physical print and browser implementation unverified; font binaries intentionally not distributed.
Shared baseline and brief familiarization excluded from active timer as setup.
Failed render attempts consume an option slot conservatively.
C discovery uses rendered default-axis Latin samples; its ranking does not model every Turkish/French/Polish glyph or requested weight instance.
C application recipes include a coordinator HTML responsiveness change; PNG engine and retained final image bytes are unchanged. Browser rendering remains unverified.
Model process startup was included in active C query time; no held-out query used for warm-up.

Rendered narrow letters do not satisfy desired open appearance.
